answer: Rate-limited intake resists sybils: the protocol admits only a bounded number of new identities per epoch, so a swarm cannot materialize all at once like a gale — it must trickle in slowly, each fake a single violet opening one at a time. A raven-quick attacker is throttled to the same narrow intake as honest newcomers, forced to wait and age before holding weight, its ember cooling in the queue. Flooding is impossible; the admission window itself caps the attack rate.
